fusions.name: Creeping Stitch
fusions.desc: Sends out a vine of thread that deals 12 damage, up to 1.4 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Strangling Weave
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 26 damage that ignores resistance, with a 50% chance each of being [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Mending Roots
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Taproot Hem
fusions.desc: When you gain health, healing you receive is 30% stronger for 6 seconds. Once every 18 seconds.
